note: The value string from the input configuration line is copied into the new_config_item and controls the lxc.rootfs.options setting.
The stored input-controlled option value is dispatched through the container config setter for the lxc.rootfs.options key.
The rootfs options setter duplicates the attacker-controlled mount option string before parsing LXC-specific mount options.
The code uses the untrusted idmap path segment length as the strlcpy destination size before checking it against sizeof(opts->userns_path).
With an idmap path longer than PATH_MAX, len is larger than the userns_path buffer and memcpy writes past the heap-allocated configuration object.
